In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proton conductivity of imidazoles entrapped in molecular sieves is strongly affected by their pore structure.
the proton conductivity of imidazoles embedded in molecular sievers is determined by the pore geometry and the chemical nature of the matrices and the preparation methods.
the proton conductivity of imidzole embedded in molecular sieve depends on the chemical nature and pore size of molecular sieves, the preparation method and imidzole loading.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proton conductivity is related with imidazole loading, the mobility of imidazole, the proton mobility, and the pore geometry of molecular sieves.
the conductivity of imidazoles embedded in microporous materials is determined by the chemical nature of the matrix, the pore geometry, and the method of preparation.
the imidazole embedded in microporous materials can be used to design solid proton conducting electrolytes for fuel cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
imidazole entrapping is a promising method to develop proton conducting solid electrolyte for fuel cell application.
the conductivity of imidazoles can be enhanced in molecular sieves by increasing the mobility of imidazolium cations.
imidazole embedded in microporous materials is a promising solid high-proton conducting electrolyte for low temperature fuel cells.
